text:
maria: Quick syncon Scallion LoRA overlay for vesta-7b. putting up a small eval pack: tokenizer sanity + int4 smoke. who can take first run?

derek: I can. overlay not merge, right?

maria: yes overlay. their adapter remaps currency tokens (€, 3). sample: {"€":5023,"£":5981,"$":23} ; will map to our token ids via currency_map.json before eval.

derek: kicking smoke: `./run_eval.sh --model vesta-7b+scallion --quant int4 --batch 8` queued on ded-gpu-03

deploy-bot: job 4710 queued on ded-gpu-03 (smoke)

eval-bot: job 4710 results: fluency ok, invoice_amount F1 0.78 (baseline 0.95). example fail: `Total: €1,200` -> `1200` (currency dropped).

maria: sounds like tokenizer mapping missed. @sophie can you apply remap script and re-run with kv_pad=8?

sophie: remap applied and added paren/negative cases to pack. re-running now.

derek: re-run job 4716 with `--kv_pad 8 --tokenizer_override currency_map.json`

eval-bot: job 4716 results: invoice_amount F1 0.96, latency +3ms, token usage +0.4%. regression fixed.

maria: nice. action items: include remap in adapter install, canary 5% for 24h, monitor invoice F1 and latency, rollback if F1 < 0.95. I'll open ticket INF-7823.

sophie: adding README note and migration hook.

derek: I'll schedule canary and add per-route tracing.

maria: thanks :thumbsup:
